name: Jesus 13th -Ushinawareta Gakuen-
original_name: ジーザス13th －喪失われた学園－
source:
After a war which wiped out more than half of the world’s population and threatened the existence of the world itself, humans have become a bit kinder. Technology innovations from the war and the discovery of new resources helped overcome the scarcity of natural resources. The black ‘wall’ which had risen to the skies has disappeared, allowing people to return to their hometowns and rebuild their lives. This was when Makina was born.

Many years later, Makina came to the elite private school Wadatsumi Gakuen perched on a cliff on the Bousou Peninsula’s large school town Yatoura-shi. He had been personally scouted and passed the entrance examination. Most graduates end up as part of the Amanor Group, which controls almost every industry in the post-war world. He had planned to be a doctor, until one day he received a letter telling him that the school’s board chairman and his grandfather, David Almatar, had died a suspicious death. As the acting board chairman, he learned about the existence of the chosen ‘pearl princess’, who is to take the sacrament from the witch’s cave. However, many mysterious beings stand in their way.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一場消滅了世界半數以上人口、威脅世界存續的戰爭之後，人類變得善良了一些。戰爭中的技術創新和新資源的發現幫助克服了天然資源的匱乏。升上天空的黑色「牆壁」消失了，讓人們得以回到家鄉重建生活。真紀奈就是在這樣的時代出生的。多年後，真紀奈來到了坐落於房總半島上大型學園城市谷浦市懸崖邊上的私立菁英學校和達津學園。他被親自招錄並通過了入學考試。大多數畢業生最終加入了戰後世界幾乎掌控所有行業的天之露集團。他原本計畫成為一名醫生，直到有一天他收到一封信，說學校的理事長兼他的祖父大衛．阿爾瑪塔死於可疑原因。作為代理理事長，他得知了被選中的「珍珠公主」的存在，她將從魔女洞窟中接受聖禮。然而，許多神秘的存在擋在了他們面前。

［來自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]］
